claims: The NASA Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
The NASA Artemis II mission has a two-hour launch window opening at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The NASA Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight around the Moon in over 50 years.
The NASA Artemis II mission will lift off from Launch Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The goal of the NASA Artemis II mission is a 10-day journey around the Moon with four astronauts.
